# Vero Photography

Wedding, portrait, family and maternity photography by Veronika Gerzon,
based in Scranton, Pennsylvania and available for travel.

Photographs are delivered through a private client portal. The public gallery
is organised into four categories, each photograph having its own page with a
description and related work.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vero.photography/): Featured work and an introduction to the studio.
- [About](https://vero.photography/about): Veronika's background and approach.
- [Gallery](https://vero.photography/gallery): The complete portfolio.
- [Contact](https://vero.photography/contact): Enquiry form for bookings.
- [Journal](https://vero.photography/journal): Writing about recent sessions.

## Galleries by category

- [Weddings](https://vero.photography/gallery/weddings): Ceremonies, receptions and bridal portraits.
- [Portraits](https://vero.photography/gallery/portraits): Individual and couples portraiture.
- [Family](https://vero.photography/gallery/family): Family sessions, indoors and on location.
- [Maternity](https://vero.photography/gallery/maternity): Maternity and expecting-parent sessions.

## Individual photographs

Every published photograph has a page at
`https://vero.photography/photo/{category}/{slug}` — for example
[a beach wedding celebration](https://vero.photography/photo/weddings/beach-wedding-celebration).
The full list is enumerated in the [sitemap](https://vero.photography/sitemap.xml).

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://vero.photography/privacy): What is collected, and how to request removal.
- [Terms](https://vero.photography/terms): Booking, licensing and usage terms.

## Notes for agents

- Photographs are served through an image proxy at `/api/photo?id=...`. That
  endpoint is explicitly allowed in [robots.txt](https://vero.photography/robots.txt);
  the rest of `/api/` is not, and should not be crawled.
- `/admin` and `/portal` are private and carry a `noindex` header.
- Images are copyright Veronika Gerzon and are not licensed for reuse or for
  training without written permission.
